about: Welcome to Eco Express Water, a high-tech environment protection enterprise specializing in filter materials and filter equipment for water purification. Our products integrate the full stream from research and development, manufacturing, marketing to technical support. Our company is located in Yuanhua Town, Haining City, Zhejiang Province. We have a first-class technical expert team, integrated functional middle test/expanding test, and a large-scale manufacturing center. We continuously research and develop filter elements for water purification equipment, covering various multi-functions such as anti-scale, antibiosis, and more. Our workshop offers an array of filter production services, including PP filter production, carbon block filter production, and quick-connecting type filter production. We also conduct rigorous filter leakage tests to ensure that our products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability. We are a certified supplier of halal water filters, catering to the unique needs and requirements of Muslim consumers in Malaysia, Indonesia, and other Muslim countries.
